scope: Selected milestones only; not exhaustive chronology or filmography.

entries.text: ସୀତା ବିବାହ (Sita Bibah) formally opens in Puri, following a Calcutta screening in March.
entries.evidence: Fresh PIB/IFFI retrospective; formal Puri opening distinguished from March Calcutta showing.
entries.canonical_note: [^foundation]: Kapilas Bhuyan, [“75 Years of Odiya Film Making: A Flashback”](https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=67399), IFFI retrospective hosted by PIB, 22 November 2010. Historical retrospective; not a 1936 programme.

entries.text: AIR Cuttack begins in the old Madhupur building.
entries.evidence: Cuttack district official history indexed paragraph; direct endpoint failed. Year only retained.
entries.canonical_note: [^district]: Cuttack district administration, [History](https://cuttack.odisha.gov.in/en/about-district/history), 1948 and the old Madhupur building.

entries.text: ଭାଇ ଭାଇ (Bhai Bhai) brings together producer Gour Prasad Ghose and director Nitai Palit.
entries.evidence: Fresh Gour-Parbati participant archive BhaiBhai credits; no first-production superlative added.
entries.canonical_note: [^bhai]: Gour–Parbati archive, [Bhai Bhai](https://www.gourparbati.com/movie_bhaibhai.php), credits and production recollections. Government assistance described retrospectively; amount unspecified.

entries.text: ମାଆ (Maa) brings Akshaya Mohanty, Pranab Patnaik and Ila Chakraborty into its playback credits, with music by Bhubaneswar Mishra.
entries.evidence: Fresh Gour-Parbati Maa credits: film year, music and playback fields.

entries.text: ଅମଡ଼ା ବାଟ (Amada Bata) adapts Basanta Kumari Patnaik’s novel, with screenplay by Gopal Chhotray and direction by Amar Ganguly.
entries.evidence: Fresh OdiaMovieDatabase film details/credits; secondary source, no original film-credit inspection.

entries.text: ମାଟିର ମଣିଷ (Matira Manisha) credits Kalindi Charan Panigrahi for its story and Mrinal Sen for screenplay and direction.
entries.evidence: Fresh Mrinal Sen official filmography: year/story/screenplay/director.
entries.canonical_note: [^film]: [Matira Manisha, Mrinal Sen filmography](https://www.mrinalsen.org/matira_manisha.html), 1966 credits and synopsis.

entries.text: Odisha Film Development Corporation is incorporated, with a remit including film production and cinema infrastructure.
entries.evidence: Fresh OFDC RTI Manual1:22.04.1976 incorporation; objectives not proof of delivery.
entries.canonical_note: [^ofdc]: Odisha Film Development Corporation, [RTI Manual 1](https://rtiodisha.gov.in/Pages/printManual/section_id:2/office_id:1345/lang), incorporation date and objectives.

entries.text: ଶୀତରାତି (Seeta Raati) receives Best Oriya Film at the 29th National Film Awards, with Balaram Misra named as producer and Manmohan Mahapatra as director.
entries.evidence: Official29thNFA catalogue downloaded; PDFp29/printed30 visual award citation for1981, coverApril1982.
entries.canonical_note: [^award]: [29th National Film Awards catalogue](https://nfaindia.org/images/pdf/29th%20National%20Film%20Award%20Catalogue.pdf), Best Oriya Film, films of 1981; award recognition in 1982.

entries.text: ମାୟା ମିରିଗ (Maya Miriga) enters the Cannes Critics’ Week selection.
Parbati Ghose’s ଛ’ ମାଣ ଆଠ ଗୁଣ୍ଠ (Chha Mana Atha Guntha) brings Fakir Mohan Senapati’s novel to the screen.
entries.canonical_note: [^adaptation]: Gour–Parbati archive, [Chha Mana Atha Guntha (1986)](https://www.gourparbati.com/movie_chha_mana_atha_guntha.php), production, screenplay, cast and technical credits.

entries.text: Doordarshan’s Odia regional satellite service begins as DD-5.
entries.evidence: Lavanya:official41stNFA PDFp29/printed30 visualawardcitation1993. DD:officialPrasarBharati2October1993regional satellite service, not firstTV.
entries.canonical_note: [^dd]: Prasar Bharati, [DD Odia](https://prasarbharati.gov.in/dd-oriya/), institutional history and linked programme catalogue, inspected 25 October 2026. 1993 service and 1994 name change; catalogue does not establish original broadcast dates.

entries.text: ଲାବଣ୍ୟ ପ୍ରୀତି (Lavanya Preeti) receives Best Children’s Film at the 41st National Film Awards, with A. K. Bir named as director.
entries.evidence: Lavanya:official41stNFA PDFp29/printed30 visualawardcitation1993. DD:officialPrasarBharati2October1993regional satellite service, not firstTV.
entries.canonical_note: [^film]: [41st National Film Awards catalogue](https://nfaindia.org/images/pdf/41st%20National%20Film%20Award%20Catalogue.pdf), award panel and printed p. 182, synopsis and credits. Official indexed text. Conflicting producer and runtime details omitted.

entries.text: ଆଦିମ ବିଚାର (Aadim Vichar) is announced as Best Odiya Film in the 62nd National Film Awards for 2014.
entries.canonical_note: [^award]: Press Information Bureau, [62nd National Film Awards results](https://www.pib.gov.in/newsite/erelcontent.aspx?lang=2&reg=48&relid=117636), 24 March 2015, Best Odiya Film.

entries.text: ପ୍ରତୀକ୍ଷା (Pratikshya) is announced as Best Odia Film in the 69th National Film Awards for 2021.
entries.canonical_note: [^award]: Press Information Bureau, [69th National Film Awards results](https://www.pib.gov.in/PressReleasePage.aspx?PRID=1951758&lang=2&reg=48), 24 August 2023, Best Odia Film for 2021.

entries.text: Il Cinema Ritrovato schedules the restored ମାୟା ମିରିଗ (Maya Miriga) in Bologna.
entries.evidence: Fresh IlCinemaRitrovato2024programme27June restoration slot; PIB70thNFA16August2024for2022DAMaN BestOdiaFilm.
entries.canonical_note: [^bologna]: Il Cinema Ritrovato, [Māyā Miriga, 2024 programme](https://festival.ilcinemaritrovato.it/en/film/maya-miriga/), 27 June screening.

entries.text: ଦମନ (DAMaN) is announced as Best Odia Film in the 70th National Film Awards for 2022.
entries.evidence: Fresh IlCinemaRitrovato2024programme27June restoration slot; PIB70thNFA16August2024for2022DAMaN BestOdiaFilm.
entries.canonical_note: [^award]: Press Information Bureau, [70th National Film Awards results](https://www.pib.gov.in/Pressreleaseshare.aspx?PRID=2045960&lang=2&reg=48), 16 August 2024, Best Odia Film. Film-category award, not Best Actor.

limits: No first-release assertion from award year.
